content.short: ETHP2P provides utilities and types to handle raw Eth peer-to-peer messages.
content.description: The ETHP2P Rust language crate provides structs and enums that encode and decode messages in a peer-to-peer network. Developers can use these types to reveal underlying network details, such as BlockHashNumber and NewPooledTransactionHashes, which indicate block identifiers and include an array of transactions that do not yet belong to any block.
